# Practo

> > Practo is a comprehensive digital healthcare platform connecting patients with verified doctors for consultations, appointments, diagnostics, and surgical care across multiple specialties.

Practo operates as an integrated telemedicine and healthcare marketplace offering 24/7 online doctor consultations, appointment booking, diagnostic testing with home collection, and end-to-end surgical care coordination. The platform serves multiple locations including San Jose and India, partnering with hospitals, diagnostic labs, and healthcare providers to deliver accessible and affordable healthcare services.

## Key Topics

- Telemedicine

## Core Healthcare Services

- [Practo Home](https://www.practo.com): Practo homepage providing access to video consultations, appointments, medicines, and lab tests.
- [Book Doctor Appointments Online](https://www.practo.com/doctors): Main healthcare platform for booking doctor appointments, ordering medicine, and diagnostic tests.
- [Online Doctor Consultation 24/7](https://www.practo.com/consult): Online telemedicine platform offering 24/7 doctor consultations via chat and call with verified doctors.

## Diagnostic & Surgical Services

- [Blood Tests & Diagnostic Tests](https://www.practo.com/tests): Diagnostic testing service offering blood tests and health checkup packages with home collection.
- [Practo Care Surgeries](https://www.practo.com/care): Surgical care service offering end-to-end support for procedures like piles, hernia, and kidney stones.

## Specialist Directories - San Jose

- [General Physicians in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/general-physician): Directory of general physicians in San Jose offering primary care and appointment booking.
- [Dentists in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/dentist): Directory of dentists in San Jose with online appointment booking and verified patient reviews.
- [Gynecologists & Obstetricians in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/gynecologist-obstetrician): Directory of gynecologists and obstetricians in San Jose with appointment booking and reviews.
- [Pediatricians in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/pediatrician): Directory of pediatricians in San Jose for children's healthcare and appointment booking.
- [Orthopedists in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/orthopedist): Directory of orthopedic specialists in San Jose for appointment booking and consultation.
- [General Surgeons in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/general-surgeon): Directory of general surgeons in San Jose with appointment booking and specialist information.
- [Gastroenterologists in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/gastroenterologist): Directory of gastroenterologists in San Jose with specialist listings and appointment booking.
- [Physiotherapists in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/physiotherapist): Directory of physiotherapists in San Jose with online booking and insurance acceptance information.
- [Dietitians & Nutritionists in San Jose](https://www.practo.com/san jose/dietitian-nutritionist): Directory of dietitians and nutritionists in San Jose for consultation and appointment booking.
